subject.title: feat(ui): hold-to-record dictation on the composer mic button

question: Should hold-to-record replace the existing long-press composer-mic behavior by default for current web users, or should it initially be opt-in?
rationale: The branch adds a persisted device-local setting whose absence defaults to enabled, changing an established interaction for existing users; the available discussion does not show an owner decision on that upgrade behavior.

options.title: Start opt-in
options.body: Default the new preference off so existing users retain the prior mic gesture while interested users enable dictation in Settings.

options.title: Approve default-on
options.body: Keep the proposed default after the provider-finalization repair and live proof demonstrate the new interaction is reliable enough to replace long-press behavior.

recommendation.title: Start opt-in
recommendation.body: Default the new preference off so existing users retain the prior mic gesture while interested users enable dictation in Settings.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the only concrete feature contact identified in the supplied implementation and follow-up history; ownership confidence is limited without current-main history inspection.
